description: This file defines the StackedKernelPass class, which implements a compiler pass for managing stacked HTTP middleware kernels in Drupal, specifically handling the collection and ordering of middleware services tagged 'http_middleware'.

classes.name: StackedKernelPass
classes.description: A compiler pass class for assembling stacked HTTP middleware kernels in Drupal, managing middleware ordering and injection.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the container to set up the stacked HTTP kernel with middleware references based on tags and priorities.

methods.name: processValue
methods.description: Processes individual service definitions to inject middleware inner references, handling union types and closures.
